     Network                                   U.S. markets open in 4h 38m                   US Markets     US Markets    Europe Markets    Asia Markets    Cryptocurrencies    Rates    Commodities    Currencies       U.S. markets open in 4h 38m                      S&P Futures    7,568.00 -6.50 -0.09%                      Dow Futures    51,848.00 -285.00 -0.55%                      Nasdaq Futures    28,198.00 +70.50 +0.25%                      Russell 2000 Futures    2,817.50 -0.30 -0.01%                      10-Yr Bond    4.8940 -0.0350 -0.71%                      VIX    21.59 +0.44 +2.08%                      Gold    3,917.30 -52.30 -1.32%                      Bitcoin USD    76,863.01 -1,091.17 -1.40%                      Crude Oil Dec 26    97.99 +1.53 +1.59%                      US Private Equity    10,836.30 -14.33 -0.13%                                   ADVERTISEMENT                            How major US stock indexes fared Monday 11/2/2026          The Associated Press   Mon, November 2, 2026 at 9:21 PM GMT 1 min read                              ^GSPC   -0.51%       ^DJI   +0.41%       ^RUT   -0.21%       ^IXIC   -1.07%       CL=F   +1.63%                     A morning rally for U.S. stocks petered out as the tech and AI industries remained shaky following their sell-off last week.

The S&P 500 fell 0.5% Monday after erasing a gain that reached 1.1% early in the day. The Dow Jones Industrial Average added 0.4%, while the Nasdaq composite fell 1.1%.

The mixed performance for indexes came even though the majority of stocks on Wall Street climbed. They benefited from a 7.6% drop for the price of a barrel of Brent crude. Nvidia swung from an early gain to a loss and helped drag the S&P 500 with it.

The S&P 500 fell 38.67 points, or 0.5%, to 7,541.40.

The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 213.67 points, or 0.4%, to 51,983.98.

The Nasdaq composite fell 272.68 points, or 1.1%, to 25,164.32.

The Russell 2000 fell 5.97 points, or 0.2%, to 2,805.88.

The S&P 500 is up 695.90 points, or 10.2%.

The Dow is up 3,920.69 points, or 8.2%.

The Nasdaq is up 1,922.33 points, or 8.3%.

The Russell 2000 is up 323.97 points, or 13.1%.
